title: A Round That Explains Its Own Clock

ciFast.note: Fast verification reruns release, format, lint, unit, proof-smoke, evaluation, build, and bundle gates after push.

ciDeep.note: Deep proof reruns build, pipeline, Chromium, Firestore rules, bundle, and strict app proof after push.

deploy.note: Deployment remains downstream of the repository's successful main workflow.

liveProvider.note: Seven real public Scion browser rounds on astro-101 and environmental-policy-unseen attribute the V0.16.78 timing gap and verify the concurrency default before and after. All runs finish at 99/A with zero P0/P1 findings and 101 extracted files per course.

manualHuman.note: No instructor, classroom, human-preference, accessibility-certification, or factual-validity claim is made. This release changes evaluation tooling only.

manualBrowser.note: Run R7 confirms the round report and round.json render the run configuration and the model-load/generation split from a real cold browser round.

claims.summary: Six controlled runs attribute the V0.16.78 2.9x round slowdown to cold model load plus GPU contention, and show V0.16.77 and V0.16.78 both generate astro-101 in 48.6s under identical warm conditions.
Browser-local providers default to one course at a time because they share a single GPU; remote providers keep the parallel default and an explicit --concurrency still wins.
The same two-course cold round finishes in 5m34s instead of 16m01s with identical 99/A grades, zero P0/P1 findings, and 101 extracted files per course.
round.json and the round report record concurrency and whether it was explicit, filmstrip capture, Scion profile mode, authoring, and voice, so two rounds can be checked for comparability.
Each course reports model load, of which download, generation, and total, so a cold profile is never mistaken for a slow product.
summarizeModelLoadPhases is a pure function over the console log each run already saves, with unit coverage for cold, warm, and remote-provider rounds, so nothing was added to the live browser path.
Gemma weights are unchanged, the research adapter remains inactive, no generated course content changes, and no quality, factual, instructor, or classroom improvement is claimed.
